capabilities: Discover recent local agent sessions grouped by project directory
Inspect session evidence, matching process IDs, working directories, and TCP listening addresses
Search and filter projects and sessions by tool and recorded activity state
Open Codex and WorkBuddy sessions via app links and copy claude --resume commands
Refresh the dashboard automatically every 30 seconds or manually
disambiguation: It does not run AI agents or send prompts; it only displays read-only status of their sessions and processes.
extras: Interface is currently in Chinese only; automatic detection works only on macOS (unsupported on Windows and Linux); not yet in the community directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub releases; reads files outside the vault (agent databases and logs) and writes snapshot files to Application Support; no telemetry, accounts, or payment.
problem: When running several local AI coding agents, there is no single view of which sessions are active, which logs need attention, or which background services are still listening.
